description: Project module for the Vityo client, owner adapters, editor runtime, agents, and platform-specific shells.
internal_components: System Styio machine-info and language-service adapters
Editor, runtime, agent, module, and platform surfaces
security_boundaries: Vityo consumes Pafio metadata and workflow JSON without reading PAFIO_HOME or private Pafio storage.
Vityo consumes system Styio contracts directly and does not install, update, pin, switch, or cache the compiler.
Hosted workspace and cloud execution requests go only through Styio Platform contracts.
Agent tools require explicit permission classification and bounded structured outputs.
Credentials and production provider data must not appear in source, fixtures, logs, or reports.

resource_classes.description: Owns the three-source split across Pafio metadata/workflow, system Styio machine contracts, and Platform hosted-workspace APIs.
resource_classes.copying_policy: Adapters normalize bounded contract fields and avoid copying private upstream state.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: Refreshes reject stale project, compiler, and hosted-workspace responses.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Missing owners or unsupported contract versions become explicit blocked capability states.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Temporary workflow overlays and subscriptions are released when workspaces or sessions change.

state_machine.source: Owner adapter implementations, public contract docs, and focused adapter tests.

transitions.on: an owner or contract is unavailable

invalid_operations: treating hosted state as local Pafio state

resource_classes.description: Owns document state, language presentation, runtime event views, agent command routing, and explicit permission flows.
resource_classes.copying_policy: Large document, diagnostic, runtime, and agent collections are indexed, bounded, or windowed before UI projection.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: Document revisions, service responses, runtime sessions, and agent turns reject stale updates.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Unavailable capabilities, routes, diagnostics, and selections use explicit empty or blocked models.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Controllers, subscriptions, caches, temporary files, and process handles are disposed with their owning workspace or session.

state_machine.source: Editor, language, runtime, agent, and shell models with focused unit and widget tests.

transitions.on: new owner facts or document revision arrives

required_tests: agent permission and command routing tests
